survey: A spiral-clipped topiary shrub in a round raised planter on a paved garden path, seen from slightly above and in front. The foliage is one continuous spiral band that winds upward in four narrowing turns from a wide base to a small leafy tip. Each turn sits on the one below it, and the band thins steadily toward the top. Ellipse E1 sits on the narrow end of the top turn, seen from the side, so its low width ratio is expected. No trunk shows, which is a normal simplification for dense topiary. The lowest turn sits on a bed of brown soil and spreads over its edge. The soil fills a closed ring of rounded stone blocks. The ring reads as round: the front blocks curve toward the camera and the back blocks show behind the shrub on both sides. The planter sits flat on the paving with no gap. The bench, lantern and hedge are background props and are not part of the object.
